output: Hearing that your team exports everything to Excel for the board pack makes sense, since spreadsheets remain part of most finance workflows, and I don't expect that to change overnight. The spreadsheet add-in can refresh your data in Excel and write changes back, so the export step can go away without asking your team to give up the Excel work they already know. Our formatted report templates also cover the common board and management layouts, and for highly custom layouts you may still finish in a spreadsheet. One customer story: [PLACEHOLDER] finance team replaced a manual monthly export with add-in refresh. If it's useful, I'd like to rebuild one of your current spreadsheet reports with you in a short working session, so we can show you where the add-in fits and where it doesn't.

<quote>

</quote>
